import z3

d = [[z3.Int(f"d_{i}_{j}") for j in range(6)] for i in range(5)]

s = z3.Solver()

# Each face value is in {0, ..., 11}
for i in range(5):
    for j in range(6):
        s.add(d[i][j] >= 0, d[i][j] <= 11)

# Sorted ascending
for i in range(5):

        s.add(d[i][j] <= d[i][j+1])

# For each i, die i beats die (i+1) mod 5: wins > 18

    win_count = z3.Sum([z3.If(d[i][a] > d[j][b], 1, 0) for a in range(6) for b in range(6)])
    s.add(win_count > 18)
